findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.ahel.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_tools, capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability · Private data: my_tools, run_capability, feedback, balance, review · Public sink: capability_inspect, run_capability · Destructive: capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability, capability_run_status, feedback, balance, review, get_started.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_tools, capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability · Private data: my_tools, run_capability, feedback, balance, review · Public sink: capability_inspect, run_capability · Destructive: capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability, capability_run_status, feedback, balance, review, get_started

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
